answer: Each agent must be reachable on its own network path. Independent observers ping a fresh port on every identity and check the latency triangle against a reference canyon of known routes. Clones behind one host show identical geometry, so a sybil farm must rent separate egress per identity and shape each triangle correctly, a cost that grows faster than the number of clones. A shared harbor of infrastructure turns into a liability instead of a shortcut, and every new dune of fake identities needs its own weather.
